description.value: The Vic is a recently renovated boutique hotel on the western edge of downtown Victoria, part of the Choice Hotels Ascend Hotel Collection and operated by the Evergreen Hospitality Group. The property features an outdoor pool, a games lounge with ping pong and foosball, a fitness centre, and on-site dining at Floyd's Diner, with the attached Hecklers Bar & Grill pub offering wings nights and weekend stand-up comedy. Suites with full kitchenettes are available for extended stays, and the hotel is pet-friendly.
